text:
Alicia (partnerships): Heads up — we're kicking off the cloud catalog activation playbook for the new publisher this week. Need to align roles, legal signoffs, and final packaging assets.
Devon (product): Nice. Which clouds are in scope? AWS + GCP + Azure?
Alicia (partnerships): Yes all three. Priority order: AWS, then GCP, then Azure. AWS needs hero image + quickstart; GCP needs trial mapping; Azure needs private-offer metadata.
Emily (solutions): Can we get the hero assets from marketing by EOD Thu? They asked for a checklist of required sizes + CTA text.
Alicia (partnerships): I'll ping marketing. For trial mapping: we need entitlement IDs, trial duration, and coupon codes. Marco, can legal pre-clear the trial terms template?
Marco (legal): I can review. Send the terms draft and any non-standard retention/KMS asks. Note: Azure wants an explicit data residency clause for some customers.
Devon (product): On technical side — we need terraform snippets for publisher infra creds (read-only), and an example of the manifest JSON that maps SKUs to plans. Emily, do you have a sample we can reuse?
Emily (solutions): Yup — here's the minimal creds snippet we use in staging:
```
provider "aws" {
  region = "us-west-2"
  assume_role {
    role_arn = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/publisher-readonly"
  }
}
```
Also attach the manifest fields: display_name, sku_code, plan_type, trial_days.
Marco (legal): Also need the publisher contract ID and whether they accept our standard indemnity. If not, mark as escalated.
Alicia (partnerships): Action list for this thread: 1) Alicia -> marketing: request hero assets + CTA copy (due Thu EOD). 2) Emily -> attach manifest example & terraform snippet to shared drive (due Wed). 3) Marco -> legal review of trial + data residency (due Fri). 4) Devon -> prepare publishing playbook (docs + curl examples) (due next Tue).
Devon (product): I'll draft the playbook. Quick question: do we want to enable autosubmit for AWS listing or keep manual publish? Pros/cons?
Emily (solutions): Recommend manual publish the first time so we can validate billing entitlements and trial flow. Autosubmit after smoke tests pass.
Alicia (partnerships): Agreed. Also, marketing wants a go/no-go sync the morning of publish. I'll put a calendar invite.
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered: marketplace-playbook/draft -> staging (build 0.4.2).
Marco (legal): One more thing — attach the redline checklist when you drop the contract. I'll mark any non-standard clauses.
Alicia (partnerships): I'll create the shared folder and upload the initial manifest and contract stub in 30m: link: https://drive.redwood/example-folder
Devon (product): Thanks — tagging @eng-ops to standby for any ingestion errors during staging publish.
Emily (solutions): I'll also prepare a short test plan for validation (billing, SSO, trial activation).
Alicia (partnerships): Great. If nothing else, I’ll post a one-line status update here after each milestone. :thumbsup:
Marco (legal): Understood.
Emily (solutions): On it.
Devon (product): 👌
Alicia (partnerships): closing for now — will follow up after I upload the artifacts.
